name: PlexiglassMountain
description: FTB Plexiglass Mountain Modded Minecraft Server FTB Plexiglass Mountain Plexiglass Mountain is a new freeplay kitchen-sink modpack by the FTB Team. With an optional quest-line, a vast variety of mods and unique custom structures generating throughout the world. Version tags available: - 1.2.4 - 1.2.3 - 1.2.2 - 1.2.1 - 1.2.0 - 1.1.1 - 1.0.2 - 1.0.1 Setup: [li]You must accept the EULA by setting the EULA variable to true or the install will fail. Optional: [li]You can setup a comma separated list of players who will have admin privileges in game by setting OPS
